film.title: AURELIA ONE | 4K CGI Product Commercial
film.description: AURELIA ONE is a fictional flagship smartphone brought to life through a fully CGI product commercial, created as a personal CG/VFX project over approximately 40 days.
film.accessibilityNote: A 47-second title-led commercial; this description covers the picture only. It opens on a black card reading "Best experienced in 4K". Metal letters spelling AURELIA, with ONE beneath, are shown at an angle in soft, dark studio light. A card reads "Engineered for detail". The back of the phone follows in close view, with two camera lenses and the words "Precision in every layer.". A faint card reads "Sculpted in titanium, introducing the world's first under-display camera". The phone's bottom edge, with speaker holes and a USB-C port, and the corner of its screen are shown in close view. The front shows a lock screen reading 09:41 beside the words "Powered by AEROS". The film ends on the back of the phone beside the words "AURELIA ONE. The future, refined.".
film.posterAlt: The back of the fictional Aurelia One phone in close view, showing two camera lenses, beside the words "Precision in every layer."
